text: Done and verified on GitHub: an hourly free check now messages you in the app (priority, with a notification) when a scheduled Claude slot leaves no check-in 5 h after its time, once per slot. Its first run read the board correctly: it sees the 07:20 ET slot as 'away' (expected, no alert) and the 13:20 ET slot isn't past its 5 h grace yet, so if that account's routine is still dead you'll get the message around 6:20 PM ET tonight (22:20Z).
